name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.mall.SpeechVoiceTiktokMallIntroduceActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a shopping ad selects the product-introduction page. It plays the product promotion and routes the user to its shop or pop-up offer.
disableEffect: The shopping-ad introduction and its associated viewing rewards will no longer be available.
